reuse.why: Extends the existing shared predicate shouldWriteMonthBudget in month-action.ts, which every month-wide action already calls, instead of adding per-action checks.

duplication.why: The hidden rule changes once in the predicate; the actions only forward the flag (the per-action category queries were already duplicated before this change and are not touched).

placement.why: The rule change lives in budget/month-action.ts, the module that holds the month-wide selection rule, with its unit tests beside it.

scope.why: Only the predicate, the six action signatures and predicate tests change.

maintainability.why: One defaulted parameter on the shared predicate with tests that pin the other exclusions.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All six month-wide actions pass the flag to shouldWriteMonthBudget.
